origin.description: Centers and scales numeric and logical columns. Logical values are 1 and 0. The scale is the sample standard deviation.

arguments.name: scale
arguments.text: TRUE divides by the sample standard deviation.

origin.details: A logical column is scaled. Other columns are left as they are.
